note: v2115: The queue P0 batch, and it is a data-loss class. Four loaders swallowed a read error into an empty dict and four savers wrote back inside the SAME function, so one bad read gave: load empty, the sweep treats everything as never-swept, save, and his ledger is gone. The savers were already torn-write safe since v1209, which protects a write that is INTERRUPTED and does nothing about a write of the WRONG THING.
